image_prompt.text: Two mirrored team bases at opposite ends of the map, red on the left and blue on the right, each sitting on its own coloured ground area and shielded from fire coming across the battlefield
A flag pole flying the team's colour standing in the open inside each base, red flag in the red base and blue flag in the blue base
Four large cartoon rocks out on the battlefield plus sandbag barriers around each base, mixing waist-high and full-body cover across the open ground
A tall watchtower in each base, reached by exposed external stairs and overlooking the battlefield
A central hill rising out of the open ground midway between the two bases
A main command building and a barracks in each base, in matching red or blue team colours
Three perimeter walls and stacked supply crates enclosing each team base
A bridge crossing a small gap in the middle of the battlefield
Four scattered trees across the open battlefield

layout_placement.text: Balanced red and blue spawn zones at opposite ends of the battlefield, out of enemy sight lines from the middle
Each base's flag stand, scored by carrying the enemy flag back to it and holding it against contest

notes: Prompt self-declares 'team deathmatch or capture the flag'. Took the Capture the Flag preset over Team Deathmatch because both bases have an explicit flag pole and flag, which only capture-zone expresses.

Preset shape substituted: kept Capture the Flag but built on open-battlefield instead of the preset's lane-network, because the prompt describes one large open area with dispersed points of interest (hill, bridge, rocks, trees) rather than parallel lanes. Same P0 baseline either way.
Dropped the preset's path-flank-tunnel: the prompt describes no subterranean or interior flanking routes, and carrying it would have forced P2, which is not ready.
Added cover-los (four rocks plus sandbag barriers) and cover-elevated (the watchtowers), both stated in the prompt but not in the preset.
cover-elevated and terrain-relief both route P0 + tiered: watchtowers and a central hill are elevation with no overhang, so no P2.

The command buildings, barracks and watchtowers are treated as exterior structures. The prompt never says players go inside, so no building-interior and no P3. Interiors could be added later but need a separate generation pass that is not ready yet.

The Attributes list (RedBaseColor, BlueBaseColor, BattlefieldColor, BridgeColor, WallCount, BaseSize) is styling and parameter metadata, not layout geometry; WallCount and BaseSize are already reflected in the three-walls count and the large-scale build.

Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?
